description: Object /views (spec 19.13 Views): the always-warm header the statusline and the status page's header show. get returns the full state; update, declared initial, carries the full state again whenever it changed, never a delta. The editor builds the same shape in-process without the daemon-only fields (pid, lw_version, session_generation, the ids).

get.description: The view's full state. Never loads the workspace.

update.description: The view's full state, sent after a model segment or a committed write that changed it (before the acknowledgement of the command that caused the change), only when it differs from the state last sent on the subscription.

state.description: As Workspace/1.header's state: loaded; unloaded before the daemon loaded the workspace; error or refused (a trust, newer-schema or journal refusal) with the load failure's message. Clients show an unknown state as neutral.

active_profile.description: The active profile's key (state loaded; absent when none).

active_profile_id.description: The active profile's opaque id (spec 19.12): present exactly when active_profile is and the view comes from the daemon.

config_set.description: The name of the active profile's configuration set (state loaded, a profile active).

config_set_id.description: That configuration set's opaque id: present exactly when config_set is and the view comes from the daemon.

error.description: The load failure (state error or refused).

diagnostics.description: The highest severity among the workspace's structural diagnostics; absent when there are none or the workspace is not loaded.

trust.description: Present only when state is refused by a trust refusal (spec 17.4): the refused file, the working copy (user) or the cache (cache).
